label: Always
design_note: Default. An unconditional slot.

label: Foe: any
design_note: Baseline foe condition.

label: Foe: lowest HP
design_note: Focus fire. Measured +16.2% at two foes.

label: Foe: highest HP
design_note: Spread damage or open with a debuff.

label: Foe: HP >= 70%
design_note: Opening-of-fight gate.

label: Foe: HP <= 30%
what_it_tests: Any foe at or below 30% HP
design_note: THE Execute gate. Execute crits only inside this window.

label: Foe: armoured (DEF > 1.4x yours)
design_note: Relative not absolute so it survives stat scaling.

label: Foe: resistant (RES > 1.4x yours)
design_note: Mirror of foe_armoured for the magic side.

label: Foe: faster than you
design_note: Tempo answer. Cripple is the best non-heal rule.

label: Foe: 2+ present
design_note: AoE gate.

label: Foe: 3+ present
design_note: Stronger AoE gate.

label: Foe: charge >= 70%
what_it_tests: A foe's charge gauge is nearly full
design_note: Telegraphed special. Lets the player pre-empt an enemy charge action.

label: Foe: softest DEF of the group
design_note: Automation half of the DEF/RES readout.

label: Foe: softest RES of the group
design_note: Automation half of the DEF/RES readout.

label: Foe: hardest hitter
design_note: Threat assessment rather than target selection.

label: Foe: acts next
design_note: Reads the turn queue directly. Pre-empts the next actor.

label: Foes: a healer among them
what_it_tests: Any foe has a healing action in its slots
design_note: Answers the Fen Priest. Kill the healer or the fight stalls.

label: Foes: ALL below 50% HP
design_note: Group-state finisher gate.

label: Foes: NONE below 70% HP
design_note: Group-state opener gate.

label: Foes: most already weakened
what_it_tests: More than half the foes carry a debuff
design_note: Targets the gap rather than the pack.

label: Foe: last one standing
design_note: Inverse of the AoE gates.

label: Foe: lacks this debuff
what_it_tests: A foe missing THIS action's status
design_note: Reads the action. Prevents wasting turns refreshing a live debuff.

label: Foe: not weakened
what_it_tests: A foe with no debuff at all
design_note: Coarser than foe_lacks_debuff.

label: Ally: HP <= 60%
design_note: The main healing gate.

label: Ally: HP <= 30%
design_note: Emergency healing gate.

label: Ally: lowest HP
what_it_tests: Most wounded ally regardless of threshold
design_note: Unconditional healing target.

label: Ally: is down
design_note: The only gate revives can use.

label: Ally: lacks this buff
what_it_tests: An ally missing THIS action's buff
design_note: Reads the action. Stops buff reapplication waste.

label: Self: HP <= 50%
design_note: Self-preservation gate.

label: Self: first turn
design_note: The Onslaught gate. x2.20 on turn one then x0.65.
